title_ru: ПОЯС — DAWN У ВЕСТЫ И ЦЕРЕРЫ
description: An interactive field guide to NASA's Dawn: the first spacecraft to orbit two worlds beyond Earth, the protoplanet Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres. Why 425 kg of xenon did the work of 30 tonnes of rocket fuel, a push as weak as the weight of a few sheets of paper, slow spirals between mapping orbits, Vesta's giant Rheasilvia basin and Ceres's salty bright spots.
og: 11.5 km/s from 425 kg of xenon, 92 mN of thrust, two worlds orbited: NASA's Dawn at Vesta and Ceres, interactive and sourced from NASA, JPL and Dawn's science papers.
